option.DuplicateAction.label: Duplicate Action
option.DuplicateAction.description:
What to do with duplicate files once a duplicate set is found:
• Move & Rename — move duplicates into _duplicates_ and rename them after the kept copy (or the first duplicate found, if Keep Which Copy is 'None'), plus a number, e.g. foo_1.png, foo_2.png
• Move — move duplicates into _duplicates_ keeping their original filenames
• Delete — send duplicates straight to the Recycle Bin

option.SimilarityMode.label: Match By
option.SimilarityMode.description:
How to find characters that were probably saved more than once:
• Similar cover image — group cards whose cover pictures look alike (perceptual hash). Different characters in the same pose can match too, so check before removing
• Same first & last name — group cards that have the same first and last name (read from the card, ignoring case)
• Similar filename — group files whose names are the same once a trailing number is removed (Rin, Rin_1, Rin (2), Rin-03); only files in the same folder are grouped — recommended after running Group Characters and Rename Characters
The matches are shown in a dialog for you to review — nothing is deleted until you click Trash selected.

option.RenameCharaPrompt.label: Rename Prompt
option.RenameCharaPrompt.description:
Instructions sent to the LLM, followed by the character JSON. When this task runs, a dialog will show the combined prompt+JSON to copy, and a Paste button to submit the LLM's reply. Tip: to change the target language, replace the words "English name" in the prompt with one of the following (keep the rest of the prompt in English — LLMs tend to understand English instructions better anyway):
• Japanese name using kanji
• Korean name using hangul
• Russian name using Cyrillic
• Chinese name using simplified Chinese characters
• Chinese name using traditional Chinese characters

option.GroupCharaIncludeSubfolders.label: Include subfolders
option.GroupCharaIncludeSubfolders.descr: Also export character cards from subfolders. Disable to skip already-sorted cards.
option.GroupScenesIncludeSubfolders.desc: Also regroup scenes that are already inside subfolders of the scene folder (off by default: only top-level scenes are moved)
option.GroupCoordinatesIncludeSubfolders: Also group coordinate cards that are already inside subfolders of the coordinate folder (off by default: only top-level coordinates are moved). Chara folders are always scanned recursively.
option.GroupCoordinatesMatchCharaHair.de: Before matching outfits, match coordinates to characters by hair: a coordinate wearing the hair accessory (on the head top; colours, positions and extra ornaments are ignored) that one character wears in any of its outfits is moved to that character's folder. A coordinate whose hair fits no character, or several characters, is left for the outfit matching, which then handles all the remaining coordinates.
option.GroupCoordinatesGroupByHair.label: Group By Hair
option.GroupCoordinatesGroupByHair.descr: After matching outfits, also group the coordinates that are still ungrouped by their hair. Every coordinate is scanned, including those in subfolders. An ungrouped coordinate whose hair matches the coordinates of one folder is moved into that folder; ungrouped coordinates that share their hair with each other (but with no folder) are moved together into a new UNKNOWN_<number> folder. If the same hair is used in several folders the coordinate is left alone. Hair means the hair accessory worn on the head top; colours and positions are ignored, and so are extra hair ornaments (ribbons, ears...): two coordinates have the same hair when the main hair (the first hair accessory on the head top) of each is also worn in the other.
option.GroupCoordinatesAccessoryToleranc: Also move a coordinate that has exactly the same clothes as one of a character's outfits but up to this many accessories added, removed or swapped. 0 (default) only moves exact copies. Keep it small (1-3): a higher value can match coordinates that merely share a common outfit.
Also move a coordinate that differs from one of a character's outfits in up to this many clothes parts (top, bottom, gloves, pantyhose...), whether in item or colours. Works together with Accessory Tolerance, which is counted separately. 0 (default) requires identical clothes. Keep it small (1-2): a higher value can match coordinates that are really different outfits.

option.SideloaderModpack.label: Sideloader Modpack
option.SideloaderModpack.description:
How to handle Sideloader Modpack mods:
• Skip — ignore modpack GUIDs entirely; only download non-modpack mods
• Only Used — download missing modpack mods that are actually used by installed cards
• All — download every GUID in the modpack index that is not installed locally
option.SideloaderModpack.case.Skip.label: Skip
option.SideloaderModpack.case.All.label: All
option.TelegramSource.label: Telegram Source
option.TelegramSource.description:
Where to look for mods not covered by BetterRepack:
• No — don't use Telegram at all
• koikatsucards.com — look up each GUID in a pre-built index (generated by scraping koikatsucards.com, no koikatsucards.com requests at run time) and download the linked Telegram message
• Telegram Chat Links — search the chats/channels below directly for a file matching the GUID
• koikatsucards.com + Telegram Chat Links — try the index first, then fall back to Telegram Chat Links for anything it couldn't find

Any Telegram option requires a Telegram account: on first use KKAFIO opens https://my.telegram.org for your API ID/Hash, then asks for your phone number and verification code. Credentials are saved in %APPDATA%/KKAFIO/config/telegram.json.
option.TelegramSource.case.No.label: No
option.TelegramSource.case.Both.label: koikatsucards.com + Telegram Chat Links
option.TelegramChatLinks.label: Telegram Chat Links
option.TelegramChatLinks.description: One Telegram channel/group/chat link per line, used when Telegram Source is 'Telegram Chat Links' or the combined option. Only private chats/groups require you to already be a member — public ones don't. Add a topic ID (e.g. .../299) to search only that forum topic; a trailing '# comment' is ignored. Chats are tried in order, moving to the next one if a chat has no match.
option.ExceptionList.label: Exception List
option.ExceptionList.description: Mods that must never be deleted, one entry per line. A line ending in '\\' is a folder inside the mods folder (e.g. 'BetterPenetration\'), a line ending in .zip or .zipmod is a filename, and anything else is a mod GUID. Lines starting with '#' are ignored. Sideloader Modpack mods are always kept.
option.Guids.label: GUIDs
option.Guids.description: One mod GUID per line to find and export. You can paste a section straight out of a Download Missing Mods report — a leading '!', '✗', '+' or '~' bullet is removed, everything from a '#' onward is treated as a comment and ignored, and every other line is used as the GUID exactly as written.

task.FilterDuplicateContents.label: 🧹 Filter Duplicate Contents
task.FilterDuplicateContents.description: Find and handle duplicate PNG cards and zipmod files
task.DownloadMissingMods.label: 📥 Download Missing Mods
task.DownloadMissingMods.description: Find mods referenced by character cards but not present in the input or output mods folder, then download them into the output mods folder from BetterRepack or via Telegram.

task.InstallContents.label: 📦 Install Contents

task.GroupScenes.label: 🎬 Group Scenes
task.GroupScenes.description: Sort Studio scenes into per-author folders by comparing their hashes to an index storing the hashes and authors of the scenes in the Pepper Scene Archive (2026/07/24). 100% accurate, but only works if the scene is found in the index / Pepper Scene Archive.
task.GroupChara.label: 🗂️ Group Characters

task.UngroupCards.label: 📂 Ungroup Cards

task.RenameChara.label: ✏️ Rename Characters
task.RenameChara.description: Translate character card names to another language using an LLM (shows a Copy/Paste dialog when run)
task.ArchiveCards.label: 🎁 Archive Cards
task.ArchiveCards.description: Bundle character cards, coordinate cards, or Studio scenes with their zipmods (and, for character cards, matching coordinates)
task.DeleteCards.label: 🗑️ Delete Cards
task.DeleteCards.description: Send character cards, coordinate cards, or Studio scenes and their associated mods/coords to Recycle Bin
task.ReviewSimilarChara.label: 🔎 Review Similar Characters
task.ReviewSimilarChara.description: Find characters that look like duplicates (similar cover, same name or similar filename), pick which to remove in a dialog, and send them to the Recycle Bin the way Delete Cards does
task.ExportMods.label: 📤 Export Mods
task.ExportMods.description: Find zipmods by GUID and copy them into an output folder, optionally renamed to [guid].zipmod
task.DeleteUnusedMods.label: ✂️ Delete Unused Mods
task.DeleteUnusedMods.description: Send zipmods that no character, scene or coordinate card uses to Recycle Bin (Sideloader Modpack mods and exception-list entries are kept)
